events.region: Alachua, FL; Gilchrist, FL
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Southwestern Alachua County in northern Florida...
Southeastern Gilchrist County in northern Florida...

* WHEN...Until 800 AM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Ponding of water in urban or other areas is occurring or is
imminent.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 602 AM EDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 1 and 3 inches of rain have
fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are expected over
the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Gainesville, Archer and University Of Florida.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: Middlesex, NJ; Somerset, NJ
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
FFWPHI

The National Weather Service in Mount Holly has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Middlesex County in northern New Jersey...
Southeastern Somerset County in northern New Jersey...

* Until 900 AM EDT.

* At 559 AM EDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across portions of the warned area. Between 1 and 2
inches of rain have fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 1 to 2
inches in 1 hour. Additional rainfall amounts up to 2 inches are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets, and underpasses as well as other
drainage and low lying areas.

* Some locations that may experience flash flooding include...
New Brunswick, Perth Amboy, Somerset, Edison, Old Bridge, East
Brunswick, Sayreville, North Brunswick, Carteret, Middlesex, Bound
Brook and Manville.

This includes the following highways...
New Jersey Turnpike between exits 10 and 13.
Interstate 287 in New Jersey between mile markers 0 and 13.
Interstate 78 in New Jersey near mile marker 42.
Garden State Parkway between mile markers 121 and 134.

FALL RIVER COUNTY AREA, NORTHERN FOOT HILLS, EASTERN FOOT HILLS,

COUNTY, WEST CENTRAL PLAINS, ZIEBACH COUNTY, HAAKON COUNTY AREA,
BADLANDS AREA, BENNETT COUNTY AREA, AND WESTON COUNTY PLAINS...

327, 328, 329, 330, 331, 332, and 333.

* TIMING...From 11 AM this morning to 8 PM MDT this evening.

* WINDS...North winds 25 to 35 mph with gusts up to 50 mph.

* IMPACTS...Any fires that develop will spread rapidly. Outdoor
burning is not recommended.
